# Nate Thomas

> Nate Thomas is an AI product manager at Momentus Technologies in Toronto, where he owns Ask Momentus, the company's flagship AI product, and leads its AI platform work: an agent-building framework and the evals strategy used across the company. He is the founder of StackKeep and the builder of TennisBud. He previously worked as a product manager at Pendo and Cvent.

## Quick facts

- Name: Nate Thomas (Nathan Thomas)
- Role: AI Product Manager, Momentus Technologies (2026–present)
- Based in: Toronto, Ontario, Canada
- Focus: AI/LLM products, AI agents, AI evals, platform and enterprise products
- Founder of: StackKeep (https://stackkeep.com)
- Education: Honors Business Administration (HBA) and English, Ivey Business School, Western University
- Contact: nathansamthomas@gmail.com · https://www.linkedin.com/in/nathansamthomas

## Experience

- **Momentus Technologies, AI Product Manager (2026–present).** Owns Ask Momentus, the flagship AI product. Led a full UX overhaul that lifted adoption 10%, and turned a single chatbot into an agent-building framework that other product teams now ship on. Wrote the evals strategy the company uses to measure AI feature quality.
- **Pendo, Product Manager, Platform & Enterprise (2025–2026).** Found through customer discovery that multi-IdP SSO was blocking enterprise deals, made the case to leadership, and shipped federation for Okta, ADFS, and AzureAD, which unlocked $10M+ ARR in Fortune 500 accounts. Led platform-wide internationalization (+10% win rates in Japan, Germany, and LatAm) and shipped an enterprise console that cut setup time by 40%.
- **Cvent, Associate Product Manager (2022–2024).** Led the 0-to-1 for an LLM-powered onboarding agent in 2022, now live with thousands of customers (+5 CSAT). Recovered $500k+ ARR through SQL cohort analysis of buyer-user misalignment, and drove +25% feature adoption by A/B testing six core product events.
- **Socotra, GTM Strategy & Operations Lead (2021).** Founding Sales Ops hire at a Series C insurance-core startup.

## Projects

- [StackKeep](https://stackkeep.com): Nate's startup. An AI agent that audits a company's Google Workspace, finds SaaS seats nobody uses, and handles cleanup in Slack. The audit is free; StackKeep charges 20% of verified savings.
- [TennisBud](https://tennisbud.vercel.app): A map of every public tennis court in Toronto, built from the City of Toronto's open data, with lights, distance, court count, and a heuristic that estimates how busy a park will be.
